title: Trader Diary: When Bitcoin Dips & Shell Explodes
content:
BTC slides 4.9% and I'm already scrolling 1‑minute candles like it's a Netflix series. Meanwhile SHELL rockets 21.8% and my FOMO alarm goes off louder than my coffee machine. 
Expectation: “I’ll wait for the dip.” Reality: “Buy the dip, sell the shell, repeat.”
lesson: If a coin’s price moves faster than your coffee brews, step back and sip before you click.
question: Who else stared at the chart until the 3 AM sunrise? Share your midnight meme moments 👇
